note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation Network (via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written in this guide's own words; facts are paraphrased from the sources named beside each trophy, never copied. Three trophies were still unconfirmed by every guide on 19 Nov 2026 and are marked as such instead of guessed at.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles)
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order: finish the five story chapters, work the 100% Completion checklist after the credits, then clean up the Strangers & Freaks strands and the last secrets. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC, and all 55 trophies are single-player.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1 — the game walks you through it and the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 1; it pops as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, opens.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after its final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the final mission and the gold pops with the ending. There is no mission replay and no difficulty setting to worry about — one playthrough is enough.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the bulk of the platinum. After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion, not a real 100%: scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars, complete 300 stunts, finish any 70 of the 80 challenges, do any 100 optional missions, rob all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations, finish all 15 target decks, and meditate at 15 of the 18 spots. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — 300 are needed for 100% Completion, so this pops on the way. Four types exist: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. Mix types freely; the under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find each stunt by name under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what you have done under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icons) to find the rest. Most come naturally from the story and other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold times are not too demanding, and the ranges are marked on the map. Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy. All 42 drone races are needed for 100% Completion, so keep racing after the trophy pops if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Repeating a race you already won does not count — each win has to be a new one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — called Video Games in-game. There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around Leonida. Finish all of a game's levels once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, you get a call from Andy, who then texts you her home address in Belville and marks the questline on the map. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops with the last one. All of it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for him; find him at the green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks shipwrecks with purple chest icons — dive down, dig the treasure out of the ocean floor with the metal detector, and bring it back to him. Clear all 7 shipwrecks; he calls you back between sets. He goes quiet during parts of the story but returns — calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up. Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops with the last one. All of it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but only certain questlines count. Confirmed to count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. All of them remain available after the story in free-roam, and you can see how many you have finished in the trophy tracker.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); he marks some on the map, and you can steal the rest off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is on the list. Delivering in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down; finishing it pops the trophy. All of it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; each spot counts double if both Jason and Lucia meditate there. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you can accept and learn to meditate with her. That home meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. The last meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Note: 100% Completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this cannot block A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline, Jason-only. After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Jason gets a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 and marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. Track progress under Map > Activities > Target Deck; there are 15 target decks and all 15 are needed for 100% Completion. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed. The questline stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered around Leonida; PowerPyx lists the locations of all 18 sets, so work from a set map and pick the three easiest to finish.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK targets with the phone app — hold Up, then R1, while looking at a scannable object. Any mix counts: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 targets in the world, so pick the easiest ones near where you already are.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges — 70 are needed for 100% Completion, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges; most complete naturally while you work on other trophies, so leave this for late and then pick the easiest ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside — available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together; call them with Right + Triangle — build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. The trophy pops once you are out of it, not when you leave the smaller flashing search area. Easiest escape: a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot follow. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between shops. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; loot a couple of items in each and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and a fourth shop still counts if the first was too quick.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic passing by. 200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100% Completion, so this pops on the way. Track discovered vehicles under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm; it slows time, highlights weak spots, and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drink, or Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor from an Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 at a gang operation where enemies group up. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and it gets much easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield or walk in through the terminal, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter a store through the back door using the Snap Gun; kicking the door trips the alarm, so use the silent option. Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe without being detected. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape — all 8 are needed for 100% Completion. Vaults open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, where you tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open; bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000, once you have done his earlier Payday Loans jobs. Vaults always trigger a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then switch cars to break recognition. Up to $205,000 per vault, the best money in the endgame.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). It pops automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since tailing the truck to a bank vault counts. Earlier method: block a truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open. Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map — fly a plane over every black-fogged area until all 52 areas of Leonida are revealed. A plane is by far the fastest way to cover the state.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 trophy list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — all 39 operations are needed for 100% Completion, so this pops on the way. Operations are marked by yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet, and this guide will not guess one. The description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the trigger is a waterfront bar or venue along Ocean Beach. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown; check back as players crack it on launch week.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window — the pop is slightly delayed, after you drive further down the street. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car — it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — it is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so come back later for what you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a gym membership and always work out together: call your partner (Right + Triangle) and while one character trains, the other trains too, doubling progress. Filter gyms on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are plenty across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — track the count by selecting the trophy in the PS5 list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and a demon face appears whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives, clean escapes and destroying evidence push you toward Professional; incapacitating enemies pushes Hardened; killing pushes Violent, then Psycho; and excessive violence pushes Irredeemable — the last is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight, so avoid it. It accrues passively through robberies and fights, so expect it late in the run.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet, and this guide will not guess one. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue ('second time's the charm'). Check back as players crack it on launch week.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods — a UFO (a bright blue light in the sky) is there. Approach it; it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random — if the car is not there, drive away and come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet, and this guide will not guess one. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle ('bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by'). Check back as players crack it on launch week.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts — a running total, not all at once. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults (Chapter 4) pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally with Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest, since they are the most expensive; Ammu-Nations, mod shops and tattoo studios are the best places to burn money. It accrues naturally while you gear up for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — about $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies fund them, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Garages also add the parking space you need for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). You need free garage space — each garage adds spots — so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage; later, from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
